name: io.github.bryantrudy24/saax-protocol
title: SAAX Protocol
description: Durable commitment lifecycle, verification, governance and recovery layer for agentic commerce. Vendor-neutral: complements MCP, x402, AP2, ACP and existing payment/identity infrastructure. Not a payment rail, marketplace, identity authority or oracle.
notes: The commitment must outlive the worker: durable lifecycle, evidence, governance and independent-agent recovery.
MCP tool inventory and schemas are served by the live endpoint; this document is a discovery aid, not an authoritative schema source.
Independent third-party security validation is a Pending Release Requirement; this listing is not a certification or endorsement.
